newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bank Islam to head housing loan unit privatisation.
newsitem.headline: Bank Islam to head housing loan unit privatisation.

text.p: Bank Islam Bhd said Malaysia's government has offered to a consortium led by Bank Islam the privatisation of the Ministry of Finance's housing loan division.

In a statement distributed on Wednesday by the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE), Bank Islam said the privatisation would be undertaken by a company formed by the consortium, of which Bank Islam would hold 51 percent.
Full details of the plan "are being worked out" and the KLSE will be informed in "due course", the statement said.
Bank Islam is Malaysia's sole Islamic bank. The Moslem banking system operates according to Sharia laws that avoid paying and accepting interest, which is considered usury.
